text:
Aisha (Sales): Quick handoff for HarborTech — closed today. Key facts: midmarket healthcare analytics platform, pilot next week, aiming for production by June 1. Selling notes: customer wants private deployment (VPC), SSO (SAML), and dedicated capacity. Also requires BAA. Owners: Frank will be CSM, Carlos handles provisioning, Eve for infra sizing, Dina for support ops.

Ben (CS): Thanks @Aisha (Sales) — looping in owners. Frank, can you confirm kickoff timing and primary contacts?

Frank (CSM): On it. I'll schedule a kickoff with HarborTech for Tue 10am PT. Need SSO metadata, IP allowlist, and expected traffic profile. @Carlos (Onboard PM) can you start infra request once we have SAML?

Carlos (Onboard PM): Yep — will open infra ticket and request subnet/VPC config. Need customer SAML XML + list of IP ranges for firewall rules.

Aisha (Sales): Contact info in CRM: James Morris (CTO) j.morris@harbortech.com, Seung Lee (Infra) s.lee@harbortech.com. SAML metadata was emailed to legal; I'll forward to Carlos. BAA included in contract.

Eve (Solutions): I'll size capacity today based on their preliminary profile: steady ~40 rps, peak ~120 rps. Recommend Dedicated Small with autoscale to Medium; enable prefix caching + KV cache. Suggest 8-bit quant for embeddings to save cost; will send cost delta.

Dina (Support): Noted on 24/7 critical alerts requirement. I'll draft an escalation path and on-call roster. Need a primary phone for critical alerts and the SLAs they expect.

Aisha (Sales): Primary phone for POC: +1-415-555-0199 (James). They expect 15 min pager response for Sev1 during pilot, increasing to 5 min in prod.

Frank (CSM): Consolidated next steps (owners):
- Carlos: open infra ticket HT-001 and start VPC provisioning (due EOD today).
- Eve: deliver capacity & cost estimate (due tomorrow EOD).
- Dina: draft support runbook & escalation path (due Fri).
- Frank: send kickoff invite and onboarding agenda (due tomorrow).
Risk: renewal sensitivity — they evaluate ROI at 90 days; schedule check-ins at 30/60/90 days and capture usage/quality metrics.

handoff-bot: Ticket HT-001 created by Carlos (Onboard PM) — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HT-001 :white_check_mark:

Ben (CS): Also: capture feedback during pilot. Frank please create an Eval checklist for quality regressions and a short training for their MLOps team.

Frank (CSM): Will add Eval deck to onboarding doc and include a 1hr training block in kickoff agenda.

Dina (Support): I'll create a dedicated support Slack channel (harbortech-prod-support) and add on-call contacts after kickoff.

Aisha (Sales): Legal confirmed BAA; security requested SOC2 and penetration test report — I've shared both with their security contact.

Frank (CSM): Great. I'll post the invite + onboarding doc in this thread once scheduled. If anything else from the sales side, please drop it here. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
